text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top panel of each block: each arm's error minus ERA5's, sorted. Lower panel: the block's two planned contrasts, the first arm minus the second. The two blocks are scored on different rows, so compare arms only within a block. No correction is made for the number of exploratory contrasts. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling calendar months and a fitting seed. Every contrast in a top panel is against ERA5, scored on that block's own rows. Hollow triangle: the same contrast at the second hyperparameter setting, shown for planned contrasts and for contrasts near the 5% line. Planned: written into the study plan before the block's first fit, which is the new product's contrast against ERA5 and against ICON-D2. Every other row is exploratory.'
text.tspan: Top panel of each block: each arm's error minus ERA5's, sorted. Lower panel: the block's two planned
contrasts, the first arm minus the second.
The two blocks are scored on different rows, so compare arms only within a block.
No correction is made for the number of exploratory contrasts.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling calendar months and a fitting seed.
Every contrast in a top panel is against ERA5, scored on that block's own rows.
Hollow triangle: the same contrast at the second hyperparameter setting, shown for planned contrasts and for
contrasts near the 5% line.
Planned: written into the study plan before the block's first fit, which is the new product's contrast against ERA5
and against ICON-D2. Every other row is exploratory.
